title: HtmlDetails
responsibility: Renders the native details element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlDetails.attributes
inputs.description: Native details attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

outputs.name: HtmlDetails
outputs.description: The actual native details element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
